baseline_ms.description: How long it ran in the baseline, in milliseconds.

file.description: Its file, when the runner names one.

test.description: The runner's ID of the test.

metrics.name: score
metrics.summary: Killed / (killed + survived + uncovered), the score; 1 when nothing was scored.

metrics.name: killed
metrics.summary: Mutants a test failed against.

metrics.name: survived
metrics.summary: Mutants every test passed against, not counting possibly equivalent ones.

metrics.name: timeout
metrics.summary: Mutants whose tests ran past their timeout.

metrics.name: out_of_memory
metrics.summary: Mutants whose tests held more than their share of max_mutant_memory and were killed.

metrics.name: uncovered
metrics.summary: Mutants no test runs, which were not run.

metrics.name: unviable
metrics.summary: Mutants that did not build or load.

metrics.name: equivalent
metrics.summary: Survivors that may behave exactly as the original (ADR-004).

metrics.name: executed
metrics.summary: Mutants run this time.

metrics.name: reused
metrics.summary: Mutants whose outcome came from an earlier run.

metrics.name: schemata
metrics.summary: Mutants run this time behind one schemata build of their file (ADR-082).

metrics.name: fallback
metrics.summary: Mutants run this time as file copies in a language with schemata; the notes say why.

metrics.name: plan_ms
metrics.summary: Milliseconds the engine spent in its plan phase this time (ADR-150): planning the mutants, their test selection, and the store's history.

metrics.name: sync_ms
metrics.summary: Milliseconds the engine spent in its sync phase this time (ADR-150): reconciling each mutation slot with the tree.

metrics.name: rewrite_ms
metrics.summary: Milliseconds the engine spent in its rewrite phase this time (ADR-150): rewriting each file as schemata.

metrics.name: build_ms
metrics.summary: Milliseconds the engine spent in its build phase this time (ADR-150): the build every mutant of a file shares, with the file's tests unmutated, per slot.

metrics.name: run_ms
metrics.summary: Milliseconds the engine spent in its run phase this time (ADR-150): the mutants' own test runs.

metrics.name: seed_ms
metrics.summary: Milliseconds the engine spent in its seed phase this time (ADR-150): copying the first slot's build into each slot with none of its own.

metrics.name: survivors
metrics.summary: Mutants of the function that survived.

metrics.name: mutation_score
metrics.summary: Killed / (killed + survived + uncovered) over the function's mutants; absent when none was scored.

metrics.name: tests
metrics.summary: Distinct tests run against the function's mutants.

settings.name: max_mutant_timeout
settings.summary: The longest a mutant's run may take, as a duration such as 90s or 5m; a run that reaches it is a timeout, whatever timeout_factor allows.

settings.name: max_mutant_memory
settings.summary: The resident memory the mutant runs may hold together, as a size such as 3g or 512m or a share of physical memory such as 50%; each slot's run gets an equal part, and a run over it is killed and is out-of-memory.

manifest.summary: Mutates the code in scope and runs the tests that cover each mutant; a mutant every test passes against survived. Score: killed / (killed + survived + uncovered): a site no test runs is not run and counts as missed (ADR-141). Outcomes of unchanged code and tests are reused from earlier runs.
